about: Joints of raven_1_fly in its source frame after reduce.py's turn (Blender axes, metres, facing -Y, its left is +X; 0.59 m beak to tail, 1.0 m across the wings here). Read off grid_front/side/top.jpg (grid.py -- 0.16 1000), 2026-11-10. The left wing (+X) is given and mirrored: shoulder, elbow, wrist, then the hand in two bones to the tip of the longest primary. No legs: they are tucked into the belly and ride with the spine.
